name: RADAR Skill Registry
description: Machine-readable capability catalog for the RADAR Core Brain. Consumed by skills/radar-intelligent-routing for capability-driven task routing; consumed by RADARMatrix as its capability catalog input.

policy.validation: tools/validate-registry.mjs must pass in CI before any status change
policy.routing: Only status=active skills are selectable. Pending-review and deprecated skills are never routed.
policy.lifecycle: See docs/GOVERNANCE.md. New skills register as pending-review and require owner review before activation.
policy.extensibility: Adding a skill = registering + validating. The router never hardcodes skill names.

domains.description: Task interpretation, capability discovery, orchestration policy

domains.description: Account, content, audience, community, trend analysis

domains.label: Agent Architecture
domains.description: AI agent design, tool contracts, guardrails, evaluation

domains.label: Artist Development
domains.description: Release operations, metadata, rights, artist growth

domains.label: Security and Governance
domains.description: Security review, skill governance, secrets discipline

skills.name: radar-intelligent-routing
skills.summary: RADAR Core Brain router: task interpretation, knowledge context retrieval, capability discovery via this registry, smallest-effective skill selection, structured prompt engineering, orchestration, verification, and governed continuity.
responsibilities: Interpret task intent and success criteria
Discover and verify available skills from the registry
Select the smallest effective skill combination
Verify outputs against skill verification criteria
expected_outputs: Route decision with rationale
Structured specialist prompt(s)
Verification result
Continuity capture
skills.tools: None assumed. Degrades to the static fallback map when files are unreadable.
limitations: Registry must be readable at run time
Does not execute specialist work itself
Grants no permissions or connector access
verification: Selected skills exist and are active
Output satisfies the original objective or the failure is routed/escalated

governance.provenance: Authored new; architecture per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md

skills.name: radar-vibe-queue
skills.summary: Legacy static task router and prompt queue: maps request types to specialist skills by name. Fallback when registry-driven routing is unavailable.
responsibilities: Route a request to the smallest useful specialist skill via the static specialist map
Serve as umbrella entry point for whole-repo import
expected_outputs: Specialist skill selection
Queued execution per QUEUE.md workflow
limitations: Name-driven, not capability-driven
Requires manual maintenance of the specialist map
Superseded by radar-intelligent-routing when the registry is available
verification: Selected specialist exists and fits the request

governance.provenance: Original router; preserved as documented fallback

skills.name: radar-meta
skills.summary: Social intelligence and account-health analysis for RADARCharts by REM: audits, content/audience analysis, community and collaboration intelligence, trends, brand reviews, growth recommendations. Analysis-only by default.
expected_outputs: Structured intelligence brief with evidence, priorities, and approval-gated actions
skills.tools: Platform-dependent social connectors; verify availability and authorization.
limitations: No consequential account changes without explicit authorization
Missing evidence is UNKNOWN, never zero
verification: Findings cite observed sources with period
Action items carry evidence, priority, risk, approval status

governance.provenance: Curated from original RADARMeta package

skills.name: agent-continuation
skills.summary: Cross-agent development continuity protocol: the HANDOFF.md ledger for multi-agent/multi-session builds. Load at the START of any coding/build task another agent may have started, and at the END before handing off.
responsibilities: Exit with verified state and a single next action
expected_outputs: Updated ledger consistent with the repo filesystem
limitations: Ledger is memory, not truth: filesystem wins
Placeholders stay placeholders
verification: A fresh agent can state current state, decisions, and next step from the ledger alone
